integrity.claim_basis: Analytical conditional block minorization and strong law, with exact two-step deterministic sign classification

scientific_limitations: Complete networks with all agents amplifying each time; common confidence radius at least four times maximal amplification; initial private opinions of magnitude at most half the maximal amplification.
Sign unanimity, not numerical equality or bounded consensus; no theorem for sparse, directed, or intermittently amplifying networks.
Deterministic constant-amplitude comparison is separate from the uniform stochastic law; finite numerical checks are not proofs.
title: Stochastic sign unanimity and deterministic parity cycles in a complete amplification network
